name: Virtual Try-On for Shops
author: mickmwanzia

sections.description:
Virtual Try-On for Shops transforms your WooCommerce store with AI-powered product visualization. Customers upload a photo and instantly see how your products look on them – boosting confidence, increasing conversions, and reducing returns.

See It In Action


Clothing Virtual Try-On Demo – See how customers can try on clothes virtually


Eyewear Virtual Try-On Demo – Perfect for glasses and sunglasses stores


Pet Accessories Support – Virtual try-on for dog and cat products

Why Store Owners Love It

  • Increase Sales: Customers buy with confidence when they see products on themselves
  • Reduce Returns: Fewer “it didn’t look like I expected” returns
  • Stand Out: Offer a shopping experience your competitors don’t have
  • Easy Setup: Get started in minutes with our streamlined onboarding

Key Features

Per-Product Control
Enable or disable virtual try-on for individual products. Override category settings with a simple dropdown in the product editor – perfect for controlling exactly which products offer the feature.

Works With Any Page Builder
Use the [vtofs_button] shortcode anywhere – Elementor, Breakdance, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Divi, or any theme. Full compatibility with custom product templates.

Smart AI for Every Product Type
Optimized AI prompts for different categories ensure realistic results:

  • Clothing – Shirts, pants, dresses, jackets, full outfits
  • Eyewear – Glasses, sunglasses with realistic reflections
  • Jewelry – Necklaces, earrings, bracelets with proper draping
  • Accessories – Ties, scarves, belts, bags, hats
  • Pet Products – Collars, bandanas, harnesses, pet clothing

Customer-Friendly Experience
* One-click photo upload
* Fast AI processing with progress indicator
* Download results to share or save
* Works on mobile, tablet, and desktop

How It Works

  1. Customer clicks “Virtual Try-On” on a product page
  2. They upload a photo of themselves (or their pet!)
  3. AI processes the image in seconds
  4. They see themselves wearing your product
  5. Confident customers add to cart

Flexible Pricing

  • Demo Mode: 10 free try-ons to test the plugin
  • Free Tier: 10 try-ons with your own Fal AI API key
  • Premium: Unlimited try-ons – pay only for AI processing

You control costs by using your own Fal AI API key. No hidden fees, no markup.

Perfect For

  • Fashion and apparel stores
  • Eyewear and optical shops
  • Jewelry and accessories retailers
  • Hat and headwear stores
  • Pet product shops
  • Any store selling wearable products

External Services

This plugin connects to external services to provide virtual try-on functionality.

Fal AI Service

Customer photos and product images are sent to Fal AI for AI processing when customers use the virtual try-on feature.

  • What’s sent: Customer photo, product image, processing instructions
  • When: Only when customer clicks “Virtual Try-On” and uploads a photo
  • Endpoint: https://fal.run/fal-ai/nano-banana/edit
  • Documentation: https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/nano-banana/edit/api

Fal AI service: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

Photos are processed in real-time and NOT stored permanently by the plugin.

License Validation Service

Premium license verification and usage tracking connects to our server.

  • What’s sent: License key (if purchased), website domain
  • When: When saving settings with a license key, or checking usage limits
  • Endpoint: https://virtualtryonwoo.com/api/v1/

Our service: Terms of Service | Privacy Policy

NO customer data or photos are sent to our server.

Support

For help and documentation: https://virtualtryonwoo.com/support

Privacy Policy

This plugin integrates with external services:

  1. Fal AI: Processes customer photos for virtual try-on. Photos are not stored permanently. See https://fal.ai/privacy

  2. License Validation: Verifies premium licenses. Only license keys and domains are sent – no customer data. See https://virtualtryonwoo.com/privacy

Ensure your privacy policy informs customers about these services.

Credits

Powered by Fal AI for advanced image processing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/virtual-tryon-for-shops/ or install via WordPress plugin installer
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Complete the quick onboarding wizard (2 minutes)
  4. Select products to enable virtual try-on
  5. The try-on button appears automatically on product pages

For page builders, use the shortcode: [vtofs_button] or [vtofs_button product_id="123"]
sections.faq:
What products work best with virtual try-on?

Clothing, accessories, glasses, jewelry, hats, and pet wearables all work great. The AI is optimized for each product type automatically.

Do I need technical skills to set it up?

No! The onboarding wizard guides you through everything. Most stores are up and running in under 5 minutes.

Can I control which products show the try-on button?

Yes! You can enable by category, by individual product, or use the per-product toggle to override settings. Full control over where the button appears.

Does it work on mobile?

Absolutely. The try-on experience is fully responsive and works great on phones and tablets.

Are customer photos stored?

No. Photos are processed by Fal AI in real-time and not stored on your server or by the plugin. Privacy is prioritized.

Can I use it with Elementor/page builders?

Yes! Use the [vtofs_button] shortcode in any page builder. It works with Elementor, Breakdance, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Divi, and others.

How much does Fal AI cost?

Fal AI charges per image processed. Typical costs are a few cents per try-on. You pay them directly with no markup from us.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • NEW: Per-product virtual try-on toggle – Enable/disable for individual products in the product editor
  • IMPROVED: Streamlined onboarding with fewer distractions
  • IMPROVED: Faster plugin activation and setup process
  • IMPROVED: Better page builder compatibility for modal display
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced stability and performance
  • FIXED: Modal now works correctly on all themes and page builders

1.0.9

  • NEW: Page builder compatibility – Added [vtofs_button] shortcode for Breakdance, Elementor, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, Divi
  • NEW: Pet product support – AI prompts for dog/cat collars, bandanas, harnesses, clothing, accessories
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced accessory accuracy with detailed prompts for ties, scarves, belts, bags, jewelry
  • IMPROVED: Better layering depth (accessories render naturally on top of clothing)
  • IMPROVED: Enhanced shadow and lighting preservation
  • IMPROVED: Color and material accuracy for metals, fabrics, textures
  • IMPROVED: Jewelry prompts with proper draping, positioning, and reflections

1.0.8

  • IMPROVED: Clarified Premium requirements – users now understand they need both license key + API key
  • IMPROVED: Better messaging distinguishing Free Tier vs Premium
  • IMPROVED: Updated notifications, FAQ, and onboarding with clear requirements

1.0.7

  • SECURITY: Demo limit properly enforced on both client and server
  • FIXED: Server configuration matches plugin limits

1.0.6

  • NEW: Smart image selection – uses first gallery image for try-on (keeps featured image for marketing)
  • NEW: Best practice banner on settings page
  • IMPROVED: Better accuracy with plain product images

1.0.5

  • IMPROVED: Real-time API key validation before saving
  • IMPROVED: AI accuracy with clearer prompts
  • FIXED: Premium license validation issues
  • FIXED: Matching sets now work as complete outfits

1.0.3

  • SECURITY: Fixed vulnerability preventing usage reset bypass
  • FIXED: Removed 5-product selection limit
  • IMPROVED: Server sync on activation

1.0.1

  • FIXED: Plugin cache and storage issues
  • ADDED: Proper deactivation cleanup
  • ADDED: Version tracking for updates

1.0.0

  • Initial release
